function relocate_blocked_navigation_goal!(env)
    zones = collect(active_restriction_zones())
    isempty(zones) && error("no active restriction zone")
    zone_keys = [first(z) for z in zones]

    report = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
    target = nothing
    for b in report.blocked
        if b.status === :engulfed && !(b.vtx in env.cache.closed_set)
            pred = env.sched.nodes[b.vtx].node
            if pred isa ConstructionBots.TransportUnitGo || pred isa ConstructionBots.RobotGo
                cfg = goal_config(env.sched.nodes[b.vtx])
                if cfg isa ConstructionBots.TransformNode
                    target = (blocked = b, config = cfg)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    target === nothing && error("no unfinished engulfed navigating goal was found")

    delta = nothing
    for z in zones
        key = first(z)
        local_report = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = [key], check_paths = true)
        responsible = any(b -> b.id == target.blocked.id && b.status === :engulfed,
                          local_report.blocked)
        if responsible
            diagnosis = zone_diagnosis(env, key)
            if diagnosis.relocate_feasible && diagnosis.relocate_delta !== nothing
                delta = diagnosis.relocate_delta
                break
            end
        end
    end
    delta === nothing && error("no lawful relocation was found for the blocked goal")

    old_transform = global_transform(target.config)
    dz = length(delta) >= 3 ? delta[3] : 0.0
    translated = CoordinateTransformations.Translation(delta[1], delta[2], dz) ∘ old_transform
    set_desired_global_transform!(target.config, translated)

    valid = false
    try
        after = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
        target_still_blocked = any(b -> b.id == target.blocked.id, after.blocked)
        valid = !target_still_blocked && !after.project_blocked
    catch err
        set_desired_global_transform!(target.config, old_transform)
        rethrow(err)
    end

    if !valid
        set_desired_global_transform!(target.config, old_transform)
        error("candidate relocation did not clear the required navigation goal")
    end

    return (; status = :success)
end

rewrite.impl_code:
function relocate_blocked_navigation_goal!(env;)
    zones = collect(active_restriction_zones())
    isempty(zones) && error("no active restriction zone")
    zone_keys = [first(z) for z in zones]

    before = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
    before.n_blocked == 0 && error("no blocked navigation goal was found")

    result = translate_whole_build!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
    if result.status === :infeasible
        error("no lawful relocation was found for the blocked goal")
    elseif result.status === :no_staging
        error("the required containing assembly could not be relocated")
    elseif result.status === :residual_blocked
        error("candidate relocation left navigation goals blocked")
    elseif result.status === :already_clear
        error("relocation produced no world edit")
    elseif result.status !== :translated
        error("unexpected relocation result")
    end

    after = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
    (after.n_blocked == 0 && !after.project_blocked) ||
        error("candidate relocation did not clear the required navigation goal")

    return (; status = :success)
end

The world was measured immediately before the body ran and again immediately after, and every measured axis was identical: closed=0 active=0 n_edges=0 n_binding_changed=0 n_weights_changed=0 n_staging_moved=0. n_binding_changed is a lower bound. These six axes are the only part of the world that was measured, so this is an observation about them and not a claim that nothing at all happened.
